text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>, Thank you for your hard 
work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.4°C (slightly low), no 
body pain. Meals: Attached records for 3 
meals."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: “Voluntary Training Report: None”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Remarks: None"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is all. Please review it. —Air 
Messiah"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look back at the daily report emails 
that had changed so drastically. 
Independent training reports that kept 
saying 'None', and a completely blank 
remarks column...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something is almost certainly wrong with 
Air Messiah. I knew that, and tried to 
talk to her whenever I had the chance, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...No, well. I don't have... anything in 
particular to consult about.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is... just as I have written in the 
daily report.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me, I'll be taking my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wouldn't give me the time of day at 
all. Those frustrating days continued on 
and on...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...I was rude to Trainer again today. 
Even though I can tell how deeply they're 
worried about me.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Even so... I don't know what to do! 
There's no way I can tell the truth—!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm just... so pathetic—!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Perfect timing. You take it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san...? When you say 'take it', do 
you mean—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Some idiot dropped it, but I'm under no 
obligation to look after it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You handle it. ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh, um...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...? Well, it's a lost item, so... Off to 
the lost and found box—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Alright. I've delivered it to the box, so 
with this—)
Hm? If it isn't Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Air Groove-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Could that be lost property? How rare. 
The student council is just about to 
collect it, but if you'd like to check it 
first—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I didn't come here looking for 
anything... I just came to deliver this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so it was as I thought. You've always 
been reliable.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it's not like I picked it up myself. 
Um... Shakur-san did...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You look pale.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Come here a second.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just eat first.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have an appetite, wash it 
down with chazuke. Get some nutrients into 
your body.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In any case. First, we start with that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...My stomach feels warm. My body is... 
starting to feel a bit toasty too—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You mean about the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you dying of anxiety over the results? 
Does the brilliance of your rivals blind 
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps both... Either way, she is 
being driven into a corner.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Wh... Why—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're asking "how did I know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, haha.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I used to be the same way.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The same...? You, Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In my case, it was the "Oaks." Right 
before that very race, where my revered 
mother had gloriously claimed the crown—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"‘Can she achieve victory across two 
generations, mother and daughter?’ ‘Can 
she run in a manner worthy of the title 
"Empress"?’ ‘Am I truly capable of 
achieving such things?’"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tangled up in all manner of doubts, she 
had no choice but to run as hard as she 
could to shake them off.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that true? I've seen the records from 
back then, but they didn't seem anything 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Records? Heh... Like the press conference 
footage for the Oaks, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, I watched it. Back then too, you 
had such a dignified expression on your 
face, Senpaiâ

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure my brow stayed furrowed, I 
slammed my forehead hard against the wall 
before the interview."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Y-You hit something...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fortunately, the swelling wasn't too 
bad, and the redness can easily be covered 
up with foundation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I do feel ashamed. I was immature. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I can say with certainty that her 
feelings were truly that profound."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Feelings...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are doubt and fear merely proof of 
vulnerability? ...I do not believe so.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Accomplish it!" "No matter what happens!" 
"Even if it costs me my all!" "Without 
fail!" "Without fail!" "Without fail!"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because I wish to believe, I doubt. 
Because I wish to achieve, I fear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of our deeply 
cherished desires that we sometimes find 
ourselves pausing in our tracks.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...I doubted. I hesitated and came to a 
halt.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (And yet, is that because... my feelings—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, talking about it has made me a bit 
hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll peel a peach. ...Want some?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'd like to eat some peaches too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "To Trainer <username>"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your hard work. Here is 
today's daily report."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 38.1°C (normal), no body 
pain. Meals: Attached records for 3 meals 
+ 1 snack. Independent training report: 
None."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Remarks:"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "I'm scared."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I really, truly want to win the Shuka 
Sho. I don't want to lose to Craft-san or 
Heart-san, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
""Still, I'm scared. I just don't feel 
like I can win.""

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“I possess no outstanding genius. I only 
know how to accumulate honest, ordinary 
effort.”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Can someone like me really win?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "I ended up doubting them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After reading through the daily report to 
the very end, I tightly grip my 
smartphone. ...This is a cry. A cry from 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly typed a reply. Forgetting my 
usual formal greetings, I just sent a 
single sentence as fast as I could.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment the message was sent, the 
laptop was flipped open immediately. 
—There was no time to lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the time it takes to return to my 
room is precious. Under the starlight, I 
wipe away sweat while typing on the 
keyboard as fast as I possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Our summer isn't over just yet.
